A bit about me

I'm Joud, a graphic and motion designer based in Riyadh. I started out studying Architecture Engineering, which is probably why I care so much about structure and proportion in my design work. A few years ago I decided to move into visual design full time, and completed a diploma in Visual Design & Motion Graphics in London.

These days I design brand identities, print, packaging, and social content, and I'm slowly building out my motion graphics work too. Kids Space is the project I'm proudest of so far, it let me design an entire brand from nothing.

I work across Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Audition.
